offering_description.value: Exponent provides engineering, environmental and health consulting to companies, law firms, insurers and government agencies. Its engineers and scientists investigate failures, test products and materials, assess environmental and health risks, and provide expert testimony.

primary_services.value: Failure and accident investigation; product design and safety evaluation; laboratory testing; litigation support and expert testimony; environmental and health risk assessment

customer_segment.value: B2B: Manufacturers, technology companies, law firms, insurers, and infrastructure owners; B2G: Government agencies commissioning technical investigations, testing, or risk assessments

end_markets.value: Legal services and insurance; technology and electronics; transportation; construction and infrastructure; chemicals and life sciences

revenue_model.value: service fees: Professional time and project expenses for investigations, testing, and advisory work; project or contract: Fixed-price engagements for defined technical assignments

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses client data, physical evidence, and laboratory tests to deliver technical findings and advice to organizations

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with operations in Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: Engineering and applied science, environmental science, and health risk consulting

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Consultants and practice teams engage directly with corporate clients, legal counsel, insurers, and agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Professional engineering licensure through state boards where required, plus workplace and laboratory safety rules
